Fresh v36 700px dark/light frames show one colored square per tag, an equal x=10–650 status row, square roster endpoints at x=212 and x=650, and no compact meter; 1,970 selected-boundary samples contain no intermediate opacity.

proposals.change_target: sheep tag simplicity, panel width allocation, and selected visibility
proposals.cause: The 3x3 bit pattern and per-slot fullness bars duplicated the roster number and selected meter, while the right-only header and linear visibility timing weakened the panel hierarchy and made a discrete lifecycle change read like fading.
proposals.candidate_change: Replace the shared 3x3 mark with one square cycling across the four contribution levels, keep the roster number as identity, remove compact roster meters, equally divide x=10–650 among 방목·양떼·잔디, space the selected sheep/tag/number/fullness and square two-row roster across their available widths, and use step-end for discrete panel visibility while preserving the intentional next-slot cue fade.
proposals.discovery_evidence: Fresh current-source 700px dark/light frames at the first turnover show the outgoing selected sheep and incoming replacement switching around the same v35 blank beat without an opacity blend. Representative, 10-, and 62-roster frames show square numbered cells reaching both endpoints with four visible palette levels and no compact bars.
proposals.reproduction: Run npm run visual:fixture and npm run check, render forced dark/light and reduced-motion representative plus 10/62 variants at 700px, inspect cue/outgoing/blank/incoming/drop/middle/terminal frames, sample selected opacity at every keyframe boundary, and rerun 30fps/120fps post-reveal continuity before independent promotion.
proposals.primary_metric: At 700px, each shared tag is one colored square, the status and lower rows use their full widths without duplicated fullness or clipping, and selected visibility has zero intermediate opacity samples while the accepted v35 handoff remains unchanged.
proposals.prediction: Removing the internal tag grid and compact meters while allocating the complete panel width will improve immediate readability without changing motion, identity lifecycle, or runtime.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if any tag is not square or loses its shared color across field, selected, and roster; fewer than four contribution colors render; the selected actor fades; compact roster fullness returns; the three status cells do not span x=10–650 equally; square roster endpoints drift from x=212–650; cue or blank handoff timing changes; dense cells clip; incoming continuity fails; runtime exceeds 50 seconds; the size guardrail fails; or npm run check fails.
proposals.regression_check: npm run check plus a fresh independent visual Gate over dark/light, reduced motion, 10/28/62 panels, adjacent turnover frames, terminal state, selected opacity boundaries, and 30fps/120fps incoming-actor continuity.
proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; this is a project-specific 700px pasture panel correction.

Preserve the v35 next-slot cue, blank handoff, exact-drop field actor, fixed UFO rhythm, causal bites, themes, reduced motion, and finale
Use only existing contribution colors, sheep art, panel cells, and number labels
